description: This source file defines utilities for processing command-line invocation strings, including unwrapping nested environment wrappers, parsing command options and modifiers, and token normalization. It appears to be part of an execution environment handling or command invocation management subsystem within a larger project.

methods.name: basenameLower
methods.description: Normalizes a filename token by trimming, replacing backslashes with slashes, and returning the lowercase basename.

methods.name: isEnvAssignment
methods.description: Checks if a token matches the pattern of an environment variable assignment (e.g., VAR=value).

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Unwraps command argument list by removing environment wrappers, returning the core command array.

methods.name: unwrapWithMetadata
methods.description: Parses the command array to strip environment wrappers and returns detailed metadata including whether modifiers are used.

methods.name: unwrapDispatchWrappersForResolution
methods.description: Recursively unwraps nested env wrapper commands, up to a configurable maximum depth.

methods.name: unwrapTransparentEnvInvocation
methods.description: Checks if a command is a transparent env invocation and returns the inner command if so.

methods.name: unwrapTransparentDispatchWrappersForResolution
methods.description: Recursively unwraps transparent env dispatch wrappers, similar to previous, for resolution.
